_about: Explicit corrections and additions applied on top of steam_api.json. The SDK headers are the ground truth; every entry names the header it comes from and why steam_api.json alone is not enough. tests/abi verifies all of it against the headers with clang.

ignoredHeaders._reason: Headers outside the flat API that the generator does not scan: isteammusicremote.h does not compile against this SDK (k_iSteamMusicRemoteCallbacks is undefined) and ISteamMusicRemote has no flat functions; the PS3 headers are obsolete.

enumBaseTypes._reason: steam_api.json records enumerators as signed 32-bit values. ERemoteStoragePlatform::k_ERemoteStoragePlatformAll is 0xffffffff in isteamremotestorage.h, which makes the C++ underlying type unsigned int with GCC and Clang (MSVC keeps int; the size is 4 bytes either way).

typedefReplacements.name: intp
typedefReplacements.reason: steamtypes.h: pointer-sized (long long on 64-bit targets, int on 32-bit); steam_api.json only records the 64-bit spelling.

typedefReplacements.name: uintp
typedefReplacements.reason: steamtypes.h: pointer-sized (unsigned long long on 64-bit targets, unsigned int on 32-bit).

typedefReplacements.name: lint64
typedefReplacements.d: version (Windows) alias lint64 = long; else alias lint64 = c_long;
typedefReplacements.reason: steamtypes.h: __int64 with MSVC but `long int` elsewhere, which is 32 bits on 32-bit Linux.

typedefReplacements.name: ulint64
typedefReplacements.d: version (Windows) alias ulint64 = ulong; else alias ulint64 = c_ulong;
typedefReplacements.reason: steamtypes.h: unsigned __int64 with MSVC but `unsigned long int` elsewhere.

manualTypes._reason: Types the generator cannot express from steam_api.json (unions, bitfields, nested types, C++ inline members). They are written by hand in the named modules and verified by tests/abi like every generated type.

manualClasses._reason: Hand-written extern(C++) classes (steamworks.raw.manual). The flat API passes them by pointer, which is a class reference in D.

manualProbe._reason: C++ field lists of hand-written types for the ABI probe. Keys are C++ qualified names.

manualEnumsProbe._reason: Hand-written enums checked by the ABI probe: D qualified name to C++ qualified name and enumerators.

manualConstsProbe._reason: Hand-written constants checked by the ABI probe: D qualified name to C++ expression.

jsonOnlyStructs._reason: Only forward-declared in the public headers (defined in steamdatagram_gamecoordinator.h, which the SDK does not ship). Their layout comes from steam_api.json; every field is naturally aligned, so the layout does not depend on packing.

opaqueTypes.name: SteamDatagramRelayAuthTicket

extraStructs.doc: Sentinel the headers use to assert the callback packing: 24 bytes with VALVE_CALLBACK_PACK_SMALL, 32 with VALVE_CALLBACK_PACK_LARGE.

jsonOnlyConsts._reason: Present in steam_api.json but defined in headers the SDK does not ship, so the ABI probe cannot check them.

cppInterfaces._reason: C++ callback interfaces the game implements and passes to ISteamMatchmakingServers. Emitted as extern(C++) abstract classes so a D subclass has the vtable layout Steam expects.

unboundExports._reason: Symbols exported by libsteam_api that the SDK headers do not declare (legacy or internal). They are intentionally not bound; tests compare this list with the library's export table.

abiVerify._reason: Exceptions for tools/gen --verify, which compares the compiler's view of the D bindings with clang's view of the SDK headers in both directions. Keys are glob patterns over entity keys such as "record X", "field X::f", "method X::m", "macro M", "function f"; every entry must match something.

cppOnly.template CCallback: C++ callback helper template built on CCallbackBase and SteamAPI_RegisterCallback/RegisterCallResult, which the bindings declare; D code subclasses CCallbackBase or uses manual dispatch.

cppOnly.function-macro *: Function-like macros of the headers generate C++ code (STEAM_CALLBACK and friends, interface accessors, VALVE_COMPILE_TIME_ASSERT) or annotate declarations for Valve's API generator (STEAM_OUT_*, STEAM_ARRAY_COUNT, STEAM_FLAT_NAME, ...); none has a C ABI counterpart.
cppOnly.macro S_API: Expands to extern "C"; the bindings declare every function extern(C).
cppOnly.macro S_CALLTYPE: Expands to __cdecl, the default C calling convention that extern(C) uses.
cppOnly.macro S_OVERRIDE: Expands to the C++ override keyword.
cppOnly.macro STEAMNETWORKINGSOCKETS_INTERFACE: Expands to extern "C" for the networking functions; see S_API.
cppOnly.inline-function Steam*: C++ accessors (SteamUser(), SteamGameServer(), ...) caching the interface pointers through SteamInternal_ContextInit; the flat API's SteamAPI_SteamUser() and friends, which the bindings declare, return the same interfaces.
cppOnly.inline-function SteamInternal_Init_*: Internal initializers of the C++ accessors (see inline-function Steam*).

dOnly._reason: D declarations with no counterpart in the headers.
dOnly.method *::toHash: D hashing that matches opEquals, so the type works as an associative-array key.
dOnly.field CGameID::GameID_t::m_appAndType: Storage of the C++ bitfields m_nAppID (24 bits) and m_nType (8 bits), which D exposes as accessor methods of the same names.
dOnly.field CGameID::GameID_t::m_nModID: The C++ 32-bit bitfield m_nModID as a plain uint32 field (same offset and size; C++ cannot take offsetof of a bitfield).
dOnly.struct ISteamNetworkingConnectionSignali: Only forward-declared in the SDK; the definition follows GameNetworkingSockets' steamnetworkingcustomsignaling.h so that D code can implement custom signaling.
dOnly.struct ISteamNetworkingSignalingRecvCont: Only forward-declared in the SDK; the definition follows GameNetworkingSockets' steamnetworkingcustomsignaling.h so that D code can implement custom signaling.
dOnly.struct SteamDatagramHostedAddress: Only forward-declared in the SDK headers; the layout comes from steam_api.json (see jsonOnlyStructs).
dOnly.struct SteamDatagramGameCoordinatorServe: Only forward-declared in the SDK headers; the layout comes from steam_api.json (see jsonOnlyStructs).
dOnly.constant k_cbSteamDatagramMaxSerializedT: Defined in headers the SDK does not ship; the value comes from steam_api.json (see jsonOnlyConsts).
dOnly.constant k_cbMaxSteamDatagramGameCoordin: Defined in headers the SDK does not ship; the value comes from steam_api.json (see jsonOnlyConsts).
dOnly.constant VALVE_CALLBACK_PACK*: D equivalents of the headers' VALVE_CALLBACK_PACK_SMALL/LARGE #pragma pack switch (empty macros in C++); tests check them against ValvePackingSentinel_t.
dOnly.declaration packAlign: D helper reproducing #pragma pack for one field.
dOnly.declaration callbackAlign: D helper reproducing VALVE_CALLBACK_PACK for one field.
dOnly.declaration SteamCallResult: D attribute naming the call result an async function completes with (the headers say so in comments).
dOnly.declaration SteamCallback: D attribute naming the callback a function pointer or function triggers.
dOnly.constant steamworksFunctionCount: D symbol table used by the dynamic loader and the export checks.
dOnly.declaration steamworksFunctionNames: D symbol table used by the dynamic loader and the export checks.
dOnly.declaration steamworksUnboundExports: D symbol table used by the dynamic loader and the export checks.
dOnly.function steamworksForEachFunction: D symbol table used by the dynamic loader and the export checks.
dOnly.function bindSteamworksSymbols: Dynamic configuration: binds every function pointer through a symbol resolver (used by steamworks.loader).
dOnly.alias SteamworksSymbolResolver: Dynamic configuration: the resolver type bindSteamworksSymbols takes.

renames._reason: D names of C++ types that have no name of their own: the anonymous union of SteamNetworkingConfigValue_t::m_val is SteamNetworkingConfigValue_t.Value in D.

constRelaxed._reason: Signatures with a C++ head-const pointer (`T *const *`), which D's transitive const can only spell as `const(T*)*`; the ABI is the same, so these compare without const.
constRelaxed.SteamAPI_ISteamNetworkingSockets_SendMes: pMessages is `SteamNetworkingMessage_t *const *` in C++ and `const(SteamNetworkingMessage_t*)*` in D.

interfaceVersionLists._reason: D constants that copy the interface version list the named inline C++ function passes to the library.
